item.title: Mississippi’s most expensive old house listing! C. 1836. $4,800,000
item.description: Welcome to Mississippi’s most expensive old house listing! Known as the Purser-Brunt Home. It was built in 1836. It is located on .96 acre in Oxford, Mississippi. The house features wood floors, wainscoting, transom windows, crown moulding, chair rails and original mantels. There are multiple outbuildings on the property. Eight bedrooms, six bathrooms and 4,979 square feet. $4,800,000 From the Zillow listing: An extremely rare opportunity to purchase the historic 1836 Purser-Brunt home awaits. L

item.title: Diamond in the Rough! The Benson House, C. 1812 in South Carolina. $250,000
item.description: Diamond in the rough! A lot of history with this house! The home was built in 1812. It is located on .32 acre in Pendleton, South Carolina. Work was started on this home and it’s waiting for someone to complete it. Once home to Enoch B. Benson, he was the town’s first mayor. Make sure you read the realtor’s write up for the complete history. There is a large covered front porch, wood floors, french doors and a lot of knotty pine. This is a big house! Four bedrooms, four bathrooms and 3,000 squar

item.title: Porch goals! C. 1907. One acre in Tennessee. $390,000
item.description: Porch goals! There are original details inside! The house was built in 1907. It is located on one acre in New Tazewell, Tennessee. The price seems a bit high to me. The house features a large wrap around front porch, wood floors, picture rails, spacious kitchen and transom windows. Four bedrooms, two bathrooms and 3,038 square feet. $390,000 Contact Brooke Miracle with Realty Executives Associates: 865-556-2350 From the Zillow listing: Step into timeless elegance with this beautifully preserved

item.title: Potential! Nice porch! Circa 1905. Almost an acre in North Carolina. $174,950
item.description: This house has nice potential! There are some nice details and a great porch! This is the type of house where you could do a good cleaning, move in and work room by room. The house was built in 1905. It is located on .98 acre in Elizabeth City, North Carolina. The house features a large wrap around porch, wood floors, nice staircase, knotty pine, baseboards, spacious kitchen and arched entryways. Three bedrooms, two bathrooms and 1,900 square feet. $174,950 Contact Susan Jenkins with Better Home

item.title: Former schoolhouse! C. 1945. On eight acres in Virginia. $425,000
item.description: This house was a former schoolhouse! Nice acreage! The school was built in 1945. It is located on eight acres in Dyke, Virginia. The house features a small covered front porch, wood floors, wide baseboards and an updated kitchen. There is an additional 78 acres that can be purchased. Two bedrooms, two bathrooms and 1,400 square feet. $425,000 Contact Andrew Hardy with Frank Hardy Sotheby’s International Realty: 213-458-4464 From the Zillow listing: This 8-acre parcel adjacent to Stone Mountain E

item.title: Two blocks to the beach! Circa 1903 in Texas. $267,000
item.description: This house is just two blocks from the beach! It’s cute! The house was built in 1903. It is located in Galveston, Texas. The house features a white picket fence, a covered front porch, oak flooring, wide baseboards, updated kitchen and updated bathrooms. The backyard is fenced in and there is a large covered back deck. Two bedrooms, two bathrooms and 980 square feet. $267,000 Contact Melissa Matyiko with Seaside Properties: 281-379-1952 From the Zillow listing: MOTIVATED SELLERS!!! Adorable 1903

item.title: Fixer upper alert! Pretty details! Circa 1900 in North Carolina. $150,000
item.description: This fixer upper has some pretty details and potential! The house was built in 1900. It is located on .3 acre in Tarboro, North Carolina. The house features a covered front porch, original wood floors, tall ceilings, crown moulding, pocket doors, wide baseboards, coffered ceiling, stained glass and a pretty staircase. The home has a big butler’s pantry. This is a big house with 4,397 square feet. $150,000 Contact Charles Alford with Tar Bucket Realty: 252-813-7477 From the Zillow listing: House

item.title: Beautiful exterior! Has a guesthouse! Almost six acres in Virginia. $1,099,000
item.description: Beautiful exterior! It’s like an Italian villa! There is a large guesthouse on the property. The main house was built in 1867. It is located on 5.94 acres in Amherst, Virginia. The interior left me a bit underwhelmed, but it is a pretty property. The house features a covered porch, wood floors, exposed brick, baseboards and brick flooring in the kitchen. There is a detached guesthouse and amazing views. Six bedrooms, six bathrooms and 3,565 square feet. $1,099,000 Contact Chris Davies with Laure

item.title: Potential! Almost three acres in Vermont. $214,900
item.description: This house has a lot of potential! Pretty landscaping out front. The house was built in 1800. It is located on 2.95 acres in Townshend, Vermont. The house features a covered front porch, baseboards, built-in bookshelves, wood floors, spacious kitchen and a large basement. This is a decent sized house! Five bedrooms, four bathrooms and 3,600 square feet. $214,900 Contact Robert Balewicz with Evergreen Realty of Vermont: 802-492-9600 From the Zillow listing: Great days ahead for the buyer of this

item.title: That sunroom! Circa 1913 in Wisconsin. $399,900
item.description: This is a pretty house! In love with the sunroom with the hanging bed! Known as the Percy Bentley House. It was built in 1913. It is located on .68 acre in West Salem, Wisconsin. The house features a lovely sunroom with hanging bed, wood floors, exposed beams, large brick fireplace, leaded glass, built-in china cabinet, updated kitchen and updated bathrooms. There is a detached two car garage. Three bedrooms, three bathrooms and 2,207 square feet. $399,900 Contact David Snyder with Gerrard – Hoe
